verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a workspace audit log of admin or user actions. Nearby admin features, such as third-party app approvals, Okta-managed access, spend limits, private teams for 'audits' (meaning confidential projects), and document version history, are adjacent controls and do not deliver a reviewable audit log. The axis clearly applies to a workspace SaaS tool, so absent evidence yields none.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can review an admin audit log of actions taken across the workspace
